findings.finding: The returned comprehension repeats a full-list sum at every position; prefix boundaries are not used.
The scanning index jumps by the substring length after a match, skipping overlapping matches.
The code emits a result per character and measures one-character slices instead of run lengths.
The slices implement a left rotation and do not reduce k modulo the list length.
A longest run ending at the final element is not included in the final maximum update.
One repair echoed feedback and prompt fragments into generated code, producing syntax errors.

interpretation: These explain observed program failures; they do not identify the neural weights causing them.
